ops.old: Cod strips in crisp beer batter with skin-on fries, chunky tartare sauce and lemon, served in paper cones like the shop on the strip. Cut 1kg potatoes into fries, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, drain, then fry again at 190C for 3 minutes. Mix 200g plain flour with 1 tsp baking powder, salt and 300ml cold beer. Cut 500g flathead fillets into strips, dust in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped gherkins, capers, dill and lemon juice. Serve in paper cones with lemon wedges.
